title: No egg questions needed: custom cakes for Rosehill and Camellia families
summary:
A Jain family in Rosehill shouldn't have to ask if a cake has eggs. Neither should a Camellia household managing an allergy, or anyone near Harris Park who's tired of explaining the same dietary line at every bakery counter.

Every cake at Num Nums is 100% eggless -- not some cakes, every cake, every single time. That's not a substitution you have to request. It's the default.

Six sizes, 15 flavours, buttercream, fondant or ganache. 48 hours minimum notice -- that's what fresh baking actually takes. Pickup from Wigram Street, open until 10pm daily, useful when Rosehill traffic runs late.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. We speak Hindi and Gujarati too.
